$schema_note: Controlled characteristic vocabulary — the classification constitution for the enrichment pipeline. Traits are grouped into five families (tone, theme, mechanics, aesthetic, structure). Each trait has a stable id, a display name, a one-sentence behavioral definition, a scale ('graded' = intensity spectrum, 'binary' = present/absent kind), 2-3 canonical anchor games, an optional distinct_from list naming the sibling traits it is most confused with, and optional steam_tag_hints used as classification priors (never as the similarity substrate). Ids are permanent FK/URL surfaces — deprecate, never rename. Id prefixes are fixed group abbreviations: tone_, theme_, mech_ (mechanics), aes_ (aesthetic), struct_ (structure). enrich_batch.py reads this file to build per-game prompts; init_db.py mirrors id/group/name/definition/scale into the characteristics table.

weight_rubric.$note: Per (game, trait) weight in [0,1] = centrality/salience of the trait to the experience. Enrichment is SPARSE: emit only traits that apply (~8-20 per game); everything else is implicitly 0. For 'graded' traits the weight reads as intensity x pervasiveness; for 'binary' traits, how central the system is.

bands.0.90-1.00: Definitional — a canonical exemplar; remove it and it is a different game.
bands.0.70-0.85: Major — you would name it in a one-sentence pitch.

tone.name: Tone
tone.description: The emotional register a game evokes — how it feels, independent of what it is about (see theme). Nearly all graded.

traits.name: Melancholic
traits.definition: A pervasive wistful sadness that finds a quiet beauty in loss and decline.

traits.name: Cozy
traits.definition: Low-stakes, comforting warmth that prioritizes safety and gentleness over tension.

traits.name: Tense
traits.definition: Sustained edge-of-seat pressure where a mistake feels imminent and costly.

traits.name: Dread
traits.definition: Slow-building anticipatory fear of a terrible thing that has not happened yet.

traits.name: Whimsical
traits.definition: Quirky, fanciful charm that delights in the imaginative and slightly absurd.

traits.name: Triumphant
traits.definition: A swelling sense of hard-won victory and heroic momentum.

traits.name: Serene
traits.definition: A calm, unhurried peace that lets the player simply be present.

traits.name: Oppressive
traits.definition: A crushing, suffocating heaviness that the world's atmosphere presses onto the player.

traits.name: Playful
traits.definition: Mischievous, teasing fun that invites the player to mess around and experiment.

traits.name: Somber
traits.definition: A grave, subdued seriousness with the hush of grief or mourning.

traits.name: Hopeful
traits.definition: An earned optimism that light and renewal are possible despite hardship.

traits.name: Bleak
traits.definition: A cold hopelessness offering little comfort or prospect of relief.

traits.name: Wistful
traits.definition: A gentle yearning nostalgia for something loved and now out of reach.
anchors: Season: A Letter to the Future

traits.name: Uncanny
traits.definition: A creeping wrongness where the almost-familiar is subtly, disturbingly off.

traits.name: Exhilarating
traits.definition: A kinetic rush of speed, flow, and thrill in the moment of play.

traits.name: Contemplative
traits.definition: An unhurried invitation to reflect, interpret, and sit with ideas.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.definition: An active, present threat that clearly intends the player harm.

traits.name: Lighthearted
traits.definition: A carefree, unburdened mood that never asks to be taken too seriously.

traits.name: Tragic
traits.definition: An arc of inevitable loss where downfall feels fated and unavertable.
anchors: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons

traits.name: Absurdist
traits.definition: Deadpan or surreal comedy built on nonsense logic and cosmic pointlessness.

traits.name: Romantic
traits.definition: A tone centered on longing, intimacy, and the pull between people.

traits.name: Lonely
traits.definition: A pervasive solitude and isolation, of a small self in a large empty space.

traits.name: Grim
traits.definition: A harsh, unflinching darkness that refuses to look away from brutality.

traits.name: Tender
traits.definition: A soft, caring gentleness that treats its subjects and player with warmth.

traits.name: Frantic
traits.definition: Overwhelming, chaotic urgency where too much happens too fast to fully control.

traits.name: Mysterious
traits.definition: An enigmatic pull of secrets half-glimpsed and answers withheld.

traits.name: Cathartic
traits.definition: A release of pent-up tension or grief that leaves the player emotionally purged.

traits.name: Sardonic
traits.definition: A dry, cynical wit that mocks with a bitter or world-weary edge.

traits.name: Earnest
traits.definition: A sincere, unironic heartfelt-ness that means every emotional beat it plays.

traits.name: Sublime
traits.definition: Awe before something vast — scale, cosmos, or the infinite — that dwarfs the self.

traits.name: Paranoid
traits.definition: Corrosive distrust where anyone or anything might be a hidden threat.

traits.name: Exuberant
traits.definition: Effervescent, high-energy joy that spills over with color and delight.

traits.name: Melodramatic
traits.definition: Heightened, operatic emotion turned up past realism for maximum impact.

traits.name: Restrained
traits.definition: A cool, minimal emotional register that trusts silence and understatement.

traits.name: Horrific
traits.definition: Visceral horror that couples terror with revulsion and the grotesque.

traits.name: Bittersweet
traits.definition: Joy and sorrow felt at once, where every gain carries a matching loss.

traits.name: Anxious
traits.definition: A jittery unease and worry that something is quietly going wrong.

traits.name: Wondrous
traits.definition: A childlike sense of wonder at discovery, magic, and the marvelous.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
Ori and the Will of the Wisps

traits.name: Irreverent
traits.definition: A gleeful disrespect that punctures seriousness, taboo, and its own genre.
anchors: South Park: The Stick of Truth

traits.name: Hypnotic
traits.definition: An entrancing, trance-like flow of rhythm and repetition that absorbs the player.

structure.name: Structure
structure.description: How play is organized across time and space — world topology, session shape, progression architecture, and multiplayer form. Mostly binary (a game either is run-based or is not), with a few graded spectra.

traits.name: Open World
traits.definition: A large continuous space explorable in a largely non-linear, player-chosen order.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

traits.name: Open Zones
traits.definition: Several large explorable regions entered discretely rather than one seamless mass.

traits.name: Sandbox
traits.definition: A systemic play space with few imposed objectives, where the player sets their own goals.

traits.name: Metroidvania
traits.definition: One continuous, ability-gated map where new traversal powers reopen earlier areas, rewarding backtracking.

traits.name: Hub-and-Spoke
traits.definition: A central hub branches out to discrete self-contained levels the player returns from.

traits.name: Linear Levels
traits.definition: Discrete stages played through in a mostly fixed order, one after another.
anchors: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

traits.name: Wide-Linear
traits.definition: A linear story spine punctuated by wide, explorable arenas and optional side content.
anchors: The Last of Us Part II

traits.name: Seamless World
traits.definition: A world traversed without loading screens or hard area boundaries.

traits.name: Handcrafted World
traits.definition: Every space is deliberately authored by designers rather than generated.

traits.name: Procedural Levels
traits.definition: Layouts are algorithmically generated so each playthrough differs.

traits.name: Dungeon Crawl
traits.definition: Progress is a descent through successive dungeon floors or chambers.

traits.name: Grid-Based Map
traits.definition: Play unfolds on a discrete tile grid that defines movement and space.

traits.name: Run-Based
traits.definition: Play is divided into discrete attempts that reset on loss, often with progress between them.

traits.name: Endless
traits.definition: No defined ending — play continues indefinitely, chasing a high score or survival.

traits.name: Campaign
traits.definition: A bounded, authored story arc with a beginning, middle, and definite end.

traits.name: Episodic
traits.definition: Content is released and structured as self-contained episodes or seasons.

traits.name: Time Loop
traits.definition: Play repeats a bounded stretch of time, with knowledge or state carried across resets.

traits.name: Timed Deadline
traits.definition: An in-fiction clock or deadline structures play and forces prioritization.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask

traits.name: New Game Plus
traits.definition: Completing the game unlocks a replay carrying over progress, with new challenge or content.

traits.name: Bite-Sized Sessions
traits.definition: Designed for short, self-contained sessions you can pick up and put down.

traits.name: Persistent World
traits.definition: A shared world that continues to exist and evolve whether or not the player is present.

traits.name: Live Service
traits.definition: Ongoing seasonal updates, battle passes, and rotating content sustain play over time.

traits.name: Day/Night Cycle
traits.definition: A recurring time-of-day cycle changes systems, threats, or opportunities.

traits.name: Meta-Progression
traits.definition: Persistent unlocks and upgrades accumulate across otherwise-resetting runs.

traits.name: Branching Narrative
traits.definition: Player choices fork the story into meaningfully different paths and outcomes.

traits.name: Nonlinear Progression
traits.definition: The player chooses the order in which objectives, regions, or content are tackled.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

traits.name: Ability-Gated
traits.definition: Progress is blocked until the player earns a specific traversal or key ability (lock-and-key).

traits.name: Tech Tree
traits.definition: A research or unlock tree progressively opens new capabilities and options.

traits.name: Skill Tree
traits.definition: The player specializes a character by spending points across branching skill nodes.

traits.name: Level & XP
traits.definition: Characters gain experience and rise in numbered levels that gate power and content.

traits.name: Prestige Loop
traits.definition: Progress is periodically reset in exchange for permanent multipliers, accelerating the next cycle.

traits.name: Mission-Based
traits.definition: Play is delivered as discrete selectable missions or contracts.

traits.name: Wave Defense
traits.definition: Play is organized around surviving successive escalating waves of enemies.

traits.name: Arena-Based
traits.definition: Combat plays out in bounded arenas rather than a traversable world.

traits.name: Stage-Based
traits.definition: Arcade-style discrete stages cleared to advance, often with a score and lives.

traits.name: Strategic Metagame Layer
traits.definition: A strategic management layer wraps and feeds into discrete tactical missions.

traits.name: Single-Player
traits.definition: Designed to be played solo, with no multiplayer component.

traits.name: Local Co-op
traits.definition: Two or more players cooperate on the same machine, in the same room.

traits.name: Online Co-op
traits.definition: Players cooperate over the internet toward shared objectives.

traits.name: Co-op Campaign
traits.definition: A full story campaign designed to be played cooperatively start to finish.

traits.name: Competitive PvP
traits.definition: Players compete directly against each other as the core mode.

traits.name: PvPvE
traits.definition: Players contend with both each other and environmental threats in the same space.

traits.name: MMO
traits.definition: Massively multiplayer: hundreds or thousands of players share a persistent online world.

traits.name: Battle Royale
traits.definition: Many players drop into a shrinking arena; the last one standing wins.

traits.name: Asymmetric Multiplayer
traits.definition: Sides play by fundamentally different rules, roles, or goals.

traits.name: Split-Screen
traits.definition: Multiple local players each get a divided portion of the screen.

traits.name: Drop-In Co-op
traits.definition: Other players can seamlessly join and leave an ongoing session.

traits.name: Asynchronous Multiplayer
traits.definition: Players affect each other's worlds without being online at the same time.

traits.name: Shared World
traits.definition: Players inhabit a common world with light, ambient interaction rather than direct teaming.

traits.name: Hotseat
traits.definition: Players take turns on a single device, passing control between them.

traits.name: Team-Based
traits.definition: Structured team-vs-team play built around coordinated roles.

traits.name: Multiple Endings
traits.definition: The game resolves in more than one distinct ending depending on play.

traits.name: High Replayability
traits.definition: Systemic variance or content depth makes repeat playthroughs meaningfully different.

traits.name: Long-Haul Scope
traits.definition: A sprawling game that expects dozens to hundreds of hours to see through.

traits.name: Short Playtime
traits.definition: A complete experience finishable in a single sitting or a few hours.

aesthetic.name: Aesthetic
aesthetic.description: The audiovisual style and presentation — visual style, camera/viewpoint, and audio identity. Style and camera are mostly binary; color-mood qualities are graded.

traits.name: Pixel Art
traits.definition: Deliberately low-resolution, hand-placed pixel visuals.

traits.name: HD-2D
traits.definition: Pixel-art sprites composited with modern 3D lighting, depth, and particle effects.

traits.name: Hand-Drawn 2D
traits.definition: Frame-by-frame hand-drawn animation and illustrated 2D art.

traits.name: Painterly
traits.definition: Hand-painted textures and visible brushwork evoking traditional media.

traits.name: Watercolor
traits.definition: Soft, translucent watercolor washes and bleeding pigment.

traits.name: Comic Book
traits.definition: Bold inked outlines, cel panels, and comic-style presentation.

traits.name: Anime Style
traits.definition: Japanese animation-inspired character design and visual language.

traits.name: Cel-Shaded
traits.definition: 3D models rendered with flat, banded shading to look drawn.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

traits.name: Low-Poly
traits.definition: Deliberately sparse, faceted 3D geometry as a stylistic choice.

traits.name: Voxel
traits.definition: Worlds and objects built from visible 3D cubes or blocks.

traits.name: Retro 3D
traits.definition: Deliberate low-fidelity PS1/N64-era 3D: chunky textures, vertex wobble, dithering.

traits.name: Photorealistic
traits.definition: High-fidelity rendering aiming to look like real footage.
anchors: The Last of Us Part II

traits.name: Stylized Realism
traits.definition: Realistic proportions and lighting pushed toward an exaggerated, painterly style.

traits.name: Flat / Vector
traits.definition: Clean flat shapes and vector art with no texture or shading noise.

traits.name: Minimalist Visuals
traits.definition: Sparse, uncluttered visuals stripped to essential shapes and space.

traits.name: Monochrome
traits.definition: A single-hue or black-and-white palette as a defining visual constraint.

traits.name: High Contrast
traits.definition: Stark tonal or color contrast drives the visual identity.

traits.name: Silhouette
traits.definition: Foreground read as dark silhouettes against luminous backgrounds.

traits.name: Vibrant Color
traits.definition: Saturated, bold color as a core part of the look and feel.

traits.name: Muted Palette
traits.definition: Desaturated, subdued colors setting a restrained mood.

traits.name: Neon
traits.definition: Glowing neon light and electric color as the signature aesthetic.

traits.name: Vaporwave
traits.definition: Retro-digital pastel, chrome, and 80s/90s consumer nostalgia aesthetic.

traits.name: Psychedelic
traits.definition: Kaleidoscopic, warping, hallucinatory visuals.

traits.name: Surreal Visuals
traits.definition: Dreamlike, impossible imagery that defies physical logic.

traits.name: Gothic
traits.definition: Ornate cathedrals, decay, and macabre grandeur define the visual world.

traits.name: Gritty
traits.definition: Grimy, worn, high-detail realism of rust, dirt, and wear.

traits.name: Brutalist
traits.definition: Stark concrete geometry and oppressive architectural mass.

traits.name: Art Deco
traits.definition: Geometric elegance, gold ornament, and retro-futurist deco design.

traits.name: Film Noir
traits.definition: Shadowy black-and-white cinematography with venetian-blind light and rain.

traits.name: Cute
traits.definition: Rounded, adorable, chibi-leaning character and world design.

traits.name: Grotesque
traits.definition: Body horror, viscera, and biomechanical revulsion as a visual language.

traits.name: Claymation
traits.definition: Stop-motion clay or sculpted models animated frame by frame.

traits.name: Papercraft
traits.definition: Worlds built to look like folded paper, cardboard, or diorama models.
anchors: The Wonderful End of the World

traits.name: ASCII / Text
traits.definition: Visuals rendered as text characters or ASCII glyphs.

traits.name: Diegetic UI
traits.definition: Interface elements exist inside the fiction rather than overlaying it.

traits.name: First-Person
traits.definition: The world is seen directly through the player character's eyes.

traits.name: Third-Person
traits.definition: The camera follows the player character from behind or above the shoulder.

traits.name: Top-Down
traits.definition: The world is viewed from directly or steeply overhead.

traits.name: Isometric
traits.definition: A fixed three-quarter angled projection of the play space.

traits.name: Side View
traits.definition: A 2D side-on profile view of the action.
anchors: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

traits.name: 2.5D
traits.definition: 3D rendering constrained to 2D-plane gameplay.

traits.name: Fixed Camera
traits.definition: Pre-set static camera angles frame each space cinematically.

traits.name: Chiptune
traits.definition: Synthesized 8-bit/16-bit-style music evoking vintage sound chips.

traits.name: Orchestral Score
traits.definition: A sweeping live-orchestra or symphonic soundtrack.
anchors: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

traits.name: Synthwave Score
traits.definition: Retro-electronic synth-driven music as the sonic identity.

traits.name: Lo-Fi
traits.definition: Warm, mellow lo-fi beats and relaxed instrumentation.

traits.name: Ambient Soundscape
traits.definition: Atmospheric drones and textures over melody, foregrounding mood.

traits.name: Licensed Soundtrack
traits.definition: Curated real-world licensed tracks drive the soundtrack.

traits.name: Dynamic Music
traits.definition: The score adapts in real time to player action and game state.

traits.name: Jazz Score
traits.definition: Jazz, swing, or big-band music defines the sonic character.

traits.name: Metal Score
traits.definition: Heavy metal or hard rock as the driving soundtrack.

traits.name: Vocal Soundtrack
traits.definition: Prominent sung vocals or choral work carry the music.

traits.name: Minimal Audio
traits.definition: Sparse or near-silent sound design that lets quiet do the work.

traits.name: Sound-Design-Forward
traits.definition: Immersive, foregrounded diegetic sound design over musical score.

traits.name: Full Voice Acting
traits.definition: The cast is fully voiced throughout, not just in cutscenes.

mechanics.name: Mechanics
mechanics.description: The core interactive systems the player operates — combat, traversal, stealth, economy, crafting, strategy, simulation, puzzle, RPG, and special systems. Mostly binary (the system is present or not); weight expresses how central it is.

traits.name: Melee Combat
traits.definition: Close-quarters weapon or fist combat is a core interaction.

traits.name: Gunplay
traits.definition: Aiming and firing ranged firearms with tactile feedback is central.

traits.name: Hack-and-Slash
traits.definition: Fast melee against many enemies with flashy chained attacks.

traits.name: Character Action
traits.definition: Deep combo-driven melee scored on stylish, expressive execution.

traits.name: Soulslike Combat
traits.definition: Deliberate, stamina-gated melee rewarding spacing, timing, and punishment of openings.

traits.name: Parry / Riposte
traits.definition: Precisely timed deflections that negate attacks and open counters.

traits.name: Dodge Roll
traits.definition: Invincibility-framed dodges are the primary defensive tool.

traits.name: Bullet Hell
traits.definition: Survival amid dense, patterned barrages of projectiles.

traits.name: Twin-Stick Shooting
traits.definition: Independent aim and movement on two sticks for omnidirectional shooting.

traits.name: Fighting-Game Combos
traits.definition: Frame-precise inputs chain into combos in 1v1 fighting.

traits.name: Cover Shooter
traits.definition: Combat built on taking cover, peeking, and suppressing fire.

traits.name: Turn-Based Combat
traits.definition: Combatants act in discrete alternating turns.

traits.name: Active Time Battle
traits.definition: Turns are gated by filling real-time action gauges.

traits.name: Grid Tactics Combat
traits.definition: Turn-based combat on a grid where positioning and range decide fights.

traits.name: Real-Time with Pause
traits.definition: Real-time combat pausable to queue party orders.

traits.name: Auto-Battle
traits.definition: The player sets up units or rules, then combat resolves automatically.

traits.name: Weapon Durability
traits.definition: Weapons and tools degrade and break with use.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

traits.name: Stagger & Poise
traits.definition: Breaking an enemy's poise opens punishing stagger windows.

traits.name: Lock-On Targeting
traits.definition: Combat orbits a locked target to manage spacing and focus.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

traits.name: Dismemberment & Gore
traits.definition: Bodies visibly break apart as a core combat feedback loop.

traits.name: Platforming
traits.definition: Jumping and navigating hazardous geometry is a core challenge.

traits.name: Precision Platforming
traits.definition: Tight, unforgiving jumps demanding frame- and pixel-level execution.

traits.name: Air Mobility
traits.definition: Double jumps, dashes, and wall-jumps grant expressive aerial control.

traits.name: Grappling Hook
traits.definition: A grapple or hook enables swinging and rapid traversal.

traits.name: Parkour
traits.definition: Fluid free-running across the environment via vaults, wall-runs, and climbs.

traits.name: Gliding & Flight
traits.definition: Sustained gliding or free flight is a core traversal mode.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

traits.name: Momentum Movement
traits.definition: Speed and inertia are conserved and skillfully chained for flow.

traits.name: Grid-Based Movement
traits.definition: The player moves one discrete tile at a time.

traits.name: Blink / Teleport
traits.definition: Short-range teleports are a core movement or combat tool.

traits.name: Swimming & Diving
traits.definition: Underwater movement and exploration is a meaningful mode.

traits.name: Vehicular Control
traits.definition: Driving, piloting, or riding vehicles is a core system.

traits.name: Climbing
traits.definition: Deliberate surface climbing with stamina or grip management.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

traits.name: Stealth
traits.definition: Avoiding detection via shadow, sound, and patrol reading is core.

traits.name: Social Stealth
traits.definition: Blending into crowds and roles to hide in plain sight.

traits.name: Detection & Awareness
traits.definition: Enemy line-of-sight, hearing, and alertness states drive tension.

traits.name: Takedowns & Assassination
traits.definition: One-shot silent eliminations reward positioning and patience.

traits.name: Resource Management
traits.definition: Scarce resources must be gathered, budgeted, and spent under pressure.

traits.name: Inventory Management
traits.definition: Organizing limited carry space and gear is a deliberate subgame.

traits.name: Trading & Economy
traits.definition: Buying, selling, and market dynamics are a core loop.

traits.name: Loot & Drops
traits.definition: Randomized item drops of varying rarity drive the reward loop.

traits.name: Gear Upgrades
traits.definition: Equipment is incrementally improved via materials or currency.

traits.name: Looter-Shooter
traits.definition: Shooting combat fused with an endless randomized loot treadmill.

traits.name: Gambling / RNG Rewards
traits.definition: Random draws, gacha, or slot-like rolls are a core reward mechanic.

traits.name: Extraction Loop
traits.definition: Enter a hostile zone, gather loot, and survive to extract or lose it.

traits.name: Crafting
traits.definition: Combining gathered materials into items via recipes is core.

traits.name: Base Building
traits.definition: Constructing and expanding a home base or settlement is central.

traits.name: Freeform Building
traits.definition: Open-ended block or part construction limited mostly by imagination.

traits.name: Automation
traits.definition: Building self-running production and logistics chains is the core loop.

traits.name: Farming
traits.definition: Growing crops and tending livestock over cycles is a core loop.

traits.name: Cooking
traits.definition: Preparing food via recipes for buffs, sale, or service is a system.

traits.name: Level Editor & UGC
traits.definition: Built-in tools let players author and share content.

traits.name: Terraforming
traits.definition: Reshaping the land itself — digging, raising, flooding — is a core tool.

traits.name: Deckbuilding
traits.definition: Assembling and refining a deck of cards is the primary progression loop.

traits.name: Card Battler
traits.definition: Cards are the units and actions of moment-to-moment combat.

traits.name: Drafting
traits.definition: Building power by picking from offered options each round or run.

traits.name: Tile Placement
traits.definition: Placing and arranging tiles or pieces to build advantage is core.

traits.name: Tower Defense
traits.definition: Placing defensive structures to stop advancing enemy waves.

traits.name: Real-Time Strategy
traits.definition: Commanding economies and armies in real time is the core.

traits.name: 4X
traits.definition: Explore, expand, exploit, exterminate across a growing empire.

traits.name: Worker Placement
traits.definition: Allocating limited workers to actions each round is the core decision.

traits.name: City Building
traits.definition: Planning and growing a functioning city is the core system.

traits.name: Colony Sim
traits.definition: Managing autonomous colonists' needs, jobs, and crises emerges into stories.

traits.name: Tycoon
traits.definition: Running a profitable business or park is the central pursuit.

traits.name: God-Game
traits.definition: Shaping a world and its people from a detached, divine vantage.

traits.name: Life Sim
traits.definition: Simulating everyday living — home, work, relationships, routine.

traits.name: Grand Strategy
traits.definition: Steering nations across politics, economy, and war at historical scale.

traits.name: Deep Simulation
traits.definition: Densely interacting simulated systems produce emergent, unscripted outcomes.

traits.name: Time Management
traits.definition: Juggling tasks against a ticking clock is the core pressure.

traits.name: Environmental Puzzles
traits.definition: Solving puzzles woven into and using the game world itself.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

traits.name: Logic Puzzles
traits.definition: Deductive, rule-based puzzles solved by reasoning.

traits.name: Physics Puzzles
traits.definition: Puzzles solved by manipulating simulated physics.

traits.name: Spatial Puzzles
traits.definition: Puzzles of geometry, perspective, and space.

traits.name: Hidden Object & Search
traits.definition: Finding, observing, and searching scenes for clues or items.

traits.name: Hacking Minigames
traits.definition: Discrete hacking or lockpick puzzles gate access.

traits.name: Match & Pattern
traits.definition: Matching colors, shapes, or patterns is the core action.

traits.name: Dialogue Trees
traits.definition: Branching conversation choices drive interaction and outcomes.

traits.name: Skill Checks
traits.definition: Character stats gate actions and dialogue via pass/fail checks.

traits.name: Reputation & Factions
traits.definition: Standing with factions shifts with your actions and opens or closes paths.

traits.name: Relationship Sim
traits.definition: Building bonds and romances with characters is a core system.

traits.name: Character Builds
traits.definition: Deep stat, skill, and gear combinations enable theorycrafted builds.

traits.name: Class System
traits.definition: Distinct character classes define roles and abilities.

traits.name: Party Management
traits.definition: Assembling and directing a squad of distinct characters is core.

traits.name: Perks & Traits
traits.definition: Selectable perks or traits grant modular passive powers.

traits.name: Moral Choice
traits.definition: Weighty ethical decisions shape the story and how you are seen.

traits.name: Leveling & Grind
traits.definition: Repeated combat to grind experience and gear is a core loop.

traits.name: Loadout Customization
traits.definition: Pre-mission tailoring of weapons, gear, and abilities is central.

traits.name: Survival Needs
traits.definition: Managing hunger, thirst, warmth, and health to stay alive is core.

traits.name: Permadeath
traits.definition: Death is permanent, resetting progress and raising the weight of each choice.

traits.name: Immersive Sim

traits.name: Emergent Systems

anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

traits.name: Physics-Driven
traits.definition: Ragdoll, momentum, and simulated forces underpin core interaction.

traits.name: Rhythm & Timing

traits.name: Quick-Time Events
traits.definition: Prompted button presses punctuate cinematic set-pieces.

traits.name: Bullet Time

traits.name: Time Manipulation

traits.name: One-Button
traits.definition: Core play is expressed through a single input, demanding timing over dexterity.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: What a game is about — its setting and genre-fiction, its subject-matter preoccupations, and its narrative mode. Distinct from tone (how it feels). Settings are largely binary; preoccupations are graded.

traits.name: High Fantasy
traits.definition: An epic secondary world of magic, myth, and grand good-versus-evil stakes.

traits.name: Dark Fantasy
traits.definition: A grim, decayed fantasy world of cruelty, curses, and moral ruin.

traits.name: Urban Fantasy
traits.definition: Magic and the supernatural hidden inside a modern, everyday world.

traits.name: Science Fiction
traits.definition: A future or speculative-technology setting extrapolated from science.

traits.name: Cyberpunk
traits.definition: High-tech, low-life futures of megacorps, augmentation, and neon decay.

traits.name: Space Opera
traits.definition: Sweeping interstellar adventure across galaxies, empires, and alien species.

traits.name: Hard Sci-Fi
traits.definition: Grounded near-plausible science and realistic physics drive the fiction.

traits.name: Post-Apocalyptic
traits.definition: Survival amid the ruins of a collapsed civilization.

traits.name: Dystopian
traits.definition: An oppressive, controlling society presented as a cautionary world.

traits.name: Utopian
traits.definition: An idealized or aspirational society, sincerely or ironically drawn.

traits.name: Cosmic Horror
traits.definition: Dread of vast, indifferent forces beyond human comprehension.

traits.name: Gothic Horror
traits.definition: Decaying estates, curses, and monstrous romance in a brooding old world.

traits.name: Psychological Horror
traits.definition: Horror rooted in the mind — paranoia, trauma, and unreliable reality.

traits.name: Zombie
traits.definition: Undead outbreak and its aftermath drive the setting.

traits.name: Supernatural & Occult
traits.definition: Ghosts, spirits, and occult forces are real and central.

traits.name: Steampunk
traits.definition: Retro-futurism of steam, brass, and Victorian industrial invention.

traits.name: Dieselpunk
traits.definition: Interwar diesel-era retro-futurism of machines, grit, and industry.

traits.name: Solarpunk
traits.definition: Hopeful eco-futures of sustainable technology and green civilization.

traits.name: Historical
traits.definition: Grounded in a real historical period and its texture.

traits.name: Alternate History
traits.definition: History diverged — a counterfactual past or present.

traits.name: Mythology
traits.definition: Draws its world and characters from established mythologies and pantheons.

traits.name: Folklore & Fairy Tale
traits.definition: Rooted in fairy tales, legends, and regional folk traditions.

traits.name: Western
traits.definition: Frontier lawlessness, gunslingers, and the American Old West.

traits.name: Medieval
traits.definition: A grounded medieval world of castles, feudalism, and knights.

traits.name: Prehistoric
traits.definition: A primeval world of early humans, megafauna, or dinosaurs.

traits.name: Contemporary
traits.definition: Set in the recognizable present-day world.

traits.name: Near-Future
traits.definition: A recognizable world a few decades ahead, tech extrapolated but familiar.

traits.name: Military & War
traits.definition: Armed forces, warfare, and combat operations as the setting.

traits.name: Espionage
traits.definition: Spies, infiltration, and covert intelligence intrigue.

traits.name: Pirates & High Seas
traits.definition: Seafaring adventure of pirates, treasure, and naval life.

traits.name: Nautical
traits.definition: The sea and life upon or beneath it is the central setting.

traits.name: School Life
traits.definition: Set around student life, classmates, and academic calendars.

traits.name: Sports
traits.definition: Athletic competition, real or invented, is the subject.

traits.name: Existential
traits.definition: Foregrounds questions of meaning, purpose, and the absurd.

traits.name: Grief & Loss
traits.definition: The experience of mourning and living with what is gone.

traits.name: Coming of Age
traits.definition: Growing up — the passage from youth to a harder self-knowledge.

traits.name: Mental Health
traits.definition: Depression, anxiety, or psychological struggle as central subject.

traits.name: Identity & Self
traits.definition: Who one is — selfhood, transformation, and self-definition.

traits.name: Memory
traits.definition: Remembering, forgetting, and the unreliability of the past.

traits.name: Mortality
traits.definition: Confronting death and the finitude of life.

traits.name: Death & Afterlife
traits.definition: The realm beyond death and the journey through it.

traits.name: Love & Romance
traits.definition: Romantic love, longing, and connection as central subject.

traits.name: Family
traits.definition: Family bonds, obligation, and inheritance drive the story.

traits.name: Friendship
traits.definition: The forging and testing of friendships is central.

traits.name: Parenthood
traits.definition: Raising, protecting, or losing a child anchors the narrative.

traits.name: War & Its Cost
traits.definition: The human toll and trauma of war, not its spectacle.

traits.name: Revolution & Class
traits.definition: Uprising, class struggle, and the overturning of an order.

traits.name: Capitalism & Labor
traits.definition: Work, money, exploitation, and economic systems as subject.

traits.name: Isolation
traits.definition: Solitude, loneliness, and being cut off from others as subject.

traits.name: Survival Against Nature
traits.definition: Enduring a hostile natural world is the central struggle.

traits.name: Faith & Religion
traits.definition: Belief, ritual, doubt, and the sacred as central concerns.

traits.name: Power & Corruption
traits.definition: The seduction and rot of power over others.

traits.name: Nature & Environment
traits.definition: The natural world and ecological concern as central subject.

traits.name: Technology & Humanity
traits.definition: What technology does to what it means to be human.

traits.name: Free Will & Determinism
traits.definition: Choice, fate, and whether the player is truly free.

traits.name: Addiction
traits.definition: Compulsion, dependency, and self-destruction as subject.

traits.name: Justice & Law
traits.definition: Law, guilt, judgment, and the pursuit of justice.

traits.name: Revenge
traits.definition: A quest for vengeance and its corrosive cost drives the arc.
anchors: The Last of Us Part II

traits.name: Colonialism
traits.definition: Conquest, empire, and the violence of settlement as subject.

traits.name: Transhumanism
traits.definition: Augmenting or transcending the human body and mind.

traits.name: AI & Consciousness
traits.definition: Machine minds, sentience, and what it means to think.

traits.name: Dreams & Subconscious
traits.definition: Dream logic and the subconscious mind as the setting.

traits.name: Time Travel
traits.definition: Moving through or altering time is central to the story.

traits.name: Political Intrigue
traits.definition: Scheming, diplomacy, and the machinery of power drive the plot.

traits.name: Mystery
traits.definition: Unraveling a central hidden truth structures the experience.
anchors: The Case of the Golden Idol

traits.name: Detective
traits.definition: Playing an investigator gathering clues to solve crimes.

traits.name: Heist
traits.definition: Planning and pulling off an elaborate robbery is the central caper.

traits.name: Journey & Pilgrimage
traits.definition: A long, transformative journey is the narrative spine.

traits.name: Redemption
traits.definition: A flawed protagonist seeking to atone drives the arc.

traits.name: Heroic Quest
traits.definition: A classic hero's journey to defeat a great evil.
anchors: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
Ori and the Will of the Wisps

traits.name: Slice of Life
traits.definition: The small texture of everyday life over dramatic plot.

traits.name: Satire & Commentary
traits.definition: Sharp social or political commentary through parody and critique.

traits.name: Horror
traits.definition: The primary aim is to frighten and disturb the player.

traits.name: Conspiracy
traits.definition: Hidden powers and vast concealed plots structure the story.

traits.name: Crime & Underworld
traits.definition: Organized crime, gangs, and the criminal underworld as setting.
